items.quote: Several respondents noted that Liodre Yanira managed prototyping novel ideas for frontline staff for their unit.
Direct reports said that Liodre Yanira managed steadying the unit after its flagship project was cancelled for their unit.
Direct reports said that Liodre Yanira drove the settlement of a long-running contract dispute for the whole division.
Direct reports said that Liodre Yanira headed public communications on the new scheme, setting priorities for several teams.
Direct reports said that Liodre championed efforts to keep unions, grassroots leaders and trade associations on side and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Peers observed that Liodre spearheaded the scenario planning exercise on future workforce needs at the national level.
Peers observed that Liodre led the partnership with sister agencies on youth services across the department.
Several respondents noted that Liodre was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of policy options for the cabinet paper on ageing.
Direct reports said that Liodre Yanira delivered their share of incident management during the ransomware attack reliably.
